description: Unique ID per refund request. RF-1xxx = web form, RF-2xxx = support desk.
Date the customer submitted the request (YYYY-MM-DD).
Months since the customer's account was created.
Number of refunds granted to this customer in the 12 months before this request.
Requested refund amount in US dollars (number).
Reason the customer selected: wrong_size, changed_mind, arrived_damaged, wrong_item, never_arrived, late_delivery.
Free text written by the customer. Optional.
Free text written by the support agent who handled the ticket. Optional.
Days between delivery (per carrier) and the request.
yes / no. Set by the payment provider's risk check.
'auto' for the existing auto-approve rule, otherwise the reviewer's name.
Anything that happened after the decision (partial amount, appeal, chargeback).
When the decision was recorded (YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM).
Minutes the reviewer spent on the request (blank for auto).
